change: Decode and optional prefix-stripping output beside the selected destination, retaining the encoded recovery spool independently. Normal publication renames on that volume instead of copying and hashing decoded bytes across volumes. A later folder edit uses the existing relocation fallback.
scope: Actual held 524,288-byte decoded sibling verified by file size and SHA-256 before Start on C: with state/spool on D:
Confirmation publishes once and leaves no old decoded sibling
Post-prefetch relocation from C: to D: completes with the exact original SHA-256 and one response
Canonical gzip, x-gzip and X-GZip; encoded-offset resume, damage rejection and form-response reuse
Two actual-executable four-MiB outputs match; each temporary final payload was removed after independent hashing
timingLimits: One before and one after launch only; no alternating trials or statistical resolution. Baseline observed Complete before final timing telemetry was saved, so its phase breakdown is unavailable. After probe waits separately for persisted phases without changing its first-Complete wall timestamp. No speed ratio, IDM latency parity or decode/flush-only gain is inferred.
ownership: Publication recovery must be clear before creating destination staging. Folder restrictions, flushes, decoder and expected/server hashes, cancellation and the publication journal remain. Cleanup preserves staging if publication recovery is pending.
remaining: Gzip decoding still follows network EOF
Initial staging uses the saved folder; an edited folder may require the existing verified copy
Broader disk-fault/crash and installed-browser/dialog timing acceptance remain separate
No installer, installation or release created
